The new constants provide a clearer and more maintainable way to check the diagnostic capabilities of the module, which directly influences how the EEPROM length is determined in the `cxgb4_get_module_info` function. This ensures that the correct length is set when diagnostics are not implemented, thereby fixing the bug related to EEPROM length handling.
